info.title: openFDA Drug Universal API
info.description: Public FDA drug datasets exposed through the official openFDA Drug API, including adverse events, structured product labeling, NDC directory records, recall enforcement reports, Drugs@FDA approvals, and drug shortages.

get.description: Counts drug adverse event records in openFDA Drug by field.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Field to count by. Use .exact for exact phrase buckets when OpenFDA requires it.

schema.description: Field to count by. Use .exact for exact phrase buckets when OpenFDA requires it.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional OpenFDA search expression to filter records before counting.

schema.description: Optional OpenFDA search expression to filter records before counting.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: An RSQL expression used to filter the results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

results.description: OpenFDA count buckets with term and count values.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
